name: Self-certified go-live
use_when: Simple services using standard components, no unusual risk.

name: Simple go-live check
use_when: Up to 25 pages, no API, no custom auth, no reviewer workflow.

name: Standard go-live review
use_when: Up to 75 pages, standard integrations, ordinary file upload.

name: Complex business review
use_when: Authentication, reviewer workflow, sensitive uploads, several API actions, or 75+ pages.

name: Professional services
use_when: Service build, migration, UX/content support, bespoke integration, delivery help.
